steps.title: Pick a secret number
steps.instruction: Start by picking a secret number from 1 to 10.
steps.hint: Use Variables to make a variable named secret.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))

steps.title: Ask for a guess
steps.instruction: Ask the player to guess a number from 1 to 10.
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait

steps.title: Check the answer
steps.instruction: If answer = secret: say “Correct!”, else say “Try again!”
steps.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [secret v] to (pick random (1) to (10))
ask [Guess a number 1 to 10] and wait
if <(answer) = (secret)> then
  say [Correct!] for (2) seconds
else
  say [Try again!] for (2) seconds
